characters.name: Sjømannen
characters.description: Den yngste kongssønnen i forkledning, i en stor matroskofte. Han later som han er en stakkars matros som har forlist, og siden kommer han som kremmer.
characters.look: A slim young man in his twenties disguised as a poor sailor, with a kind face, a straight nose, steady green-grey eyes and a few days' dark stubble, his wavy dark-brown hair tucked under a red kerchief knotted round his head. characters.name: Den yngste prinsessa
characters.description: Prinsessa som sørger i stillhet og beskytter seg med et blankt sverd, og som til slutt tør å si hvem som virkelig reddet dem.
characters.look: A small, slight princess of about twenty with a round, solemn face, a short nose, deep-blue eyes under thick, level brows and a small, determined mouth. Her honey-brown hair is braided into a crown around her head. She wears a long ivory gown stitched with gold at the bodice and hem, with tight long sleeves and a narrow gold girdle, and a little silver anchor pinned at her collar.

characters.name: Fugl Dam
characters.description: En enorm fugl som spiser fire tønner rug til frokost og flyr kongssønnen og gullkronene over havet til trollprinsen.
characters.look: An enormous, friendly bird as tall as a three-storey house, so big that a man reaches only to its ankle, shaped a little like a giant gull. It has a pale silver-grey back, broad silver-grey wings with black tips, a snowy-white head and breast, kind dark eyes, a big hooked golden-yellow beak and huge orange webbed feet. From the back of its neck rises one enormous, stiff, copper-red feather, as thick as a young spruce.

characters.name: Ridder Rød
characters.description: Styrmann og rival som blir misunnelig, sviker den yngste prinsen og prøver å ta æren for redningen for å få den yngste prinsessa.
characters.look: A tall, barrel-chested, vain man of about forty with a big square jaw, a cleft chin, a short straight nose held high, small, cold pale-blue eyes and a proud smirk. He has short flame-red hair and a short, pointed flame-red beard. He wears a round, polished steel helmet with a stiff red crest, a long scarlet surcoat with a gold border over a shirt of chainmail, a wide black belt with a big gold buckle and tall black boots.

characters.name: Trollkongen med tolv hoder
characters.description: Stortrollet med tolv hoder, som sitter pyntet i en flott sal mens de tolv prinsessene plukker lus av ham, til den yngste kongssønnen hogger hodene av.
characters.look: A huge, hulking troll about three times as tall as a man, with rust-red, warty skin, a broad, sagging barrel of a body, very long arms that hang down to the floor and short bowed legs. On his thick neck sits a bunch of exactly twelve small heads, packed tightly together like a bunch of turnips, each with a knobbly nose, droopy ears and a wispy tuft of pale straw-coloured hair. He wears a moth-eaten dark-blue velvet cloak with a tattered fur collar and heavy gold chains.

characters.name: Trollprinsen
characters.description: Et stort og stygt troll på øya, som gir kongssønnen sverdet og flaska, og som blir konge når trollkongen er borte.
characters.look: A huge, strange troll about three times as tall as a man, shaped like a giant sack of flour, with sloping shoulders, a small head, a big soft belly, short legs and huge webbed feet like a duck's. His skin is a weathered, ruddy tan. He has a nose as long as a cucumber, small kind amber eyes, big ears like cabbage leaves and a stiff crest of dark-brown hair standing straight up like a brush. He wears a mulberry-purple velvet tunic with a wide gold belt.

characters.name: Trollprinsessa
characters.description: Trollprinsens datter. Først er hun en liten hund som bjeffer og piper på en øy, så en vakker prinsesse. I mange år syr hun klær og lintøy til kongssønnen.
characters.look: A willowy young woman of about twenty with pale, milky skin, a long, narrow face, a tiny pointed nose, big silvery-grey eyes and long, pale-blonde hair that floats and drifts around her as if she were under water. A thin, misty veil floats around her too, as if lifted by a breeze. She wears a long, flowing apricot-coloured dress with a silver belt and goes barefoot.

characters.name: Kongen
characters.description: Kongen med de tolv døtrene, som er så glad i dem at han helst vil ha dem hos seg hele tiden.
characters.look: A small, wiry, elderly king with a narrow, kind, crinkly face, a small sharp nose, twinkling blue eyes, wisps of silver hair and a long silver-grey beard braided into two plaits tied with little gold rings. He wears a low, wide gold crown set with green stones, a long turquoise robe with a collar of spotted grey sealskin and silver clasps shaped like fish, and soft grey felt slippers.

characters.name: Den nysgjerrige kjerringa
characters.description: Ei gammel kjerring i ei falleferdig hytte, som spør og graver og løper rett til de andre sladrekjerringene med nyheten.
characters.look: A short, bustling old woman with a plump little body on thin legs, like a robin, and a long neck that she cranes forward to see everything. She has a sharp little chin, a beaky nose, big curious eyes magnified by thick, round spectacles and wispy white hair scraped into a tiny topknot like an onion. She wears a faded lavender dress, an orange knitted shawl and a patched brown apron with a deep pocket.

Inside, twelve small golden crowns sit side by side, shining so brightly that golden light fills the hall. The Youngest Princess steps forward with tears in her eyes and points straight at the Sailor. Her eleven sisters crowd round the cupboard, the King leans forward from his tall chair in amazement, and Sir Red stands stiff and pale.

- Sir Red: A tall, barrel-chested, vain man of about forty with a big square jaw, a cleft chin, a short straight nose held high, small, cold pale-blue eyes and a proud smirk. He has short flame-red hair and a short, pointed flame-red beard. He wears a round, polished steel helmet with a stiff red crest, a long scarlet surcoat with a gold border over a shirt of chainmail, a wide black belt with a big gold buckle and tall black boots.

Setting:
- the Great Hall: The great hall of the royal manor by the sea: a long, high log hall with a steep, dark-beamed roof, walls hung with red and blue woven tapestries, small-paned windows looking out over the sea, a long carved table with benches, a big stone fireplace, and at the far end, on a low platform, a tall carved royal chair and a long cushioned bench.

Story world: Old Norway by the sea, over fourteen years of voyages. The princesses' father rules a royal manor of big log halls above a sandy beach. The twelve princes sail in one big, round-bellied wooden ship. On a small rocky island stands the troll prince's castle, with a tall hall of pale stone columns; far across the sea, the Black Castle on a rocky shore holds the Troll King's gilded chamber. The little dog on the island is fluffy and white, with floppy brown ears. The old sword is long and rusty, with a plain iron hilt; the troll's bottle is round, of dark-green glass. The crown cupboard is waist-high, painted blue with red-and-white rosemaling, and holds twelve small golden crowns. The iron boat is small and dark, with no oars or sail. The eleven older princes wear matching grey-blue coats; the eleven older princesses wear long dresses in soft colours.

This story's season, light and colours: The open northern sea in all its moods, from howling gales to glassy calm: jade-green and pewter-grey waves with white foam, towering silver-grey clouds, pale luminous summer nights and clear rosy dawns. Indoors, warm lamplight and the rich glow of gold. Accents: Sir Red's scarlet, the prince's forest green and gleaming golden crowns.

Art style: Classic Norwegian folk-tale book illustration: fine pen-and-ink line work with transparent watercolour washes on warm, slightly textured off-white paper, in the tradition of 19th-century Scandinavian book illustration, like the plates of an old printed book of folk tales, with a deep red that comes back as the accent. The picture fills the whole image, with no border, frame or lettering. Naturalistic proportions and expressive, characterful faces; every character has their own face, build, age and hair exactly as described, so no two characters look alike. Muted natural palette of fjord teal, slate blue, moss green, lichen grey, honey ochre, lingonberry red, ink black and birch white, shifted towards each story's own season, light and colours, with the warm cream paper showing through the washes, with dramatic Nordic light: low sun, long shadows, blue dusk and firelight. Old rural Norway: dark spruce and pine forests, steep mountains, fjords, turf-roofed log farms, carved wood, homespun wool and linen. Trolls are enormous, ancient and earthy, like pieces of the landscape come alive, made of moss, bark, stone and lichen, and more grotesque-comic than frightening.
